\chapter{Skill commands}\label{ch:skill}
Typed to an AI agent that has the skill (Chapter~\ref{ch:setup}). Syntax: \texttt{akeyless-watchover <command> [args]}, the agent's own skill syntax, or the MCP prompt \texttt{watchover-<command>}. Arguments are free text; a plain-language request is mapped to the closest command. Every command ends with the verification that applies and the VERIFY caveats that touch the answer. Example answers are abridged and vary with the agent and model.

\section{\texttt{help}}\label{skill:help}
\begin{woentry}
\refrow{Syntax}{\texttt{akeyless-\allowbreak{}watchover help [command]}}
\refrow{Does}{Show this guide, or the details of one skill command.}
\refrow{Delivers}{The command table, parameters and examples.}
\refrow{How}{\begin{itemize}[nosep,leftmargin=1.2em]
\item Reads references/usage-guide.md (or the command table in SKILL.md).
\item With an argument, returns only that command's entry. Parameters are never invented.
\end{itemize}
}
\end{woentry}
\IfFileExists{sessions/help.tex}{\input{sessions/help.tex}}{}

\section{\texttt{design}}\label{skill:design}
\begin{woentry}
\refrow{Syntax}{\texttt{akeyless-\allowbreak{}watchover design \textless{}diagram \textbar{}\allowbreak{} description of BUs,\allowbreak{} apps,\allowbreak{} environments,\allowbreak{} personas\textgreater{}}}
\refrow{Does}{Translate an organisation/structure diagram into Akeyless configuration.}
\refrow{Delivers}{Path tree, access matrix, YAML model (roles, auth methods, folders), access expectations, plan expectations, CLI equivalent.}
\refrow{How}{\begin{itemize}[nosep,leftmargin=1.2em]
\item Inventories BUs, applications, environments, data classes, personas and the identity source of each; asks for whatever is missing.
\item Derives the path tree \texttt{/\allowbreak{}\textless{}bu\textgreater{}/\allowbreak{}\textless{}app\textgreater{}/\allowbreak{}\textless{}env\textgreater{}/\allowbreak{}...} (delegation boundary first, carve-outs such as \texttt{break-\allowbreak{}glass} as fixed segments) and the access matrix persona x scope.
\item Creates one role per persona x scope x access level; binds humans through the SSO auth method + \texttt{groups} sub-claims and workloads through one auth method per trust boundary.
\item Writes the model files and access\_expectations.yaml, then runs \texttt{watchover simulate}/\texttt{test} when it can run commands.
\end{itemize}
}
\end{woentry}
\IfFileExists{sessions/design.tex}{\input{sessions/design.tex}}{}

\section{\texttt{change}}\label{skill:change}
\begin{woentry}
\refrow{Syntax}{\texttt{akeyless-\allowbreak{}watchover change \textless{}access request in plain words\textgreater{}}}
\refrow{Does}{Change existing access with the smallest possible model diff.}
\refrow{Delivers}{Diff of model/roles/\textless{}bu\textgreater{}.yaml (and auth\_methods.yaml if needed), new expectations, who must approve (CODEOWNERS).}
\refrow{How}{\begin{itemize}[nosep,leftmargin=1.2em]
\item Finds the role file of the owning business unit (model/roles/\textless{}bu\textgreater{}.yaml).
\item Applies the smallest change: a rule, an association, narrower sub-claims - or a new role when no existing role has the right audience.
\item Adds a positive and a negative expectation, simulates, and lists the CODEOWNERS approvers.
\end{itemize}
}
\end{woentry}
\IfFileExists{sessions/change.tex}{\input{sessions/change.tex}}{}

\section{\texttt{review}}\label{skill:review}
\begin{woentry}
\refrow{Syntax}{\texttt{akeyless-\allowbreak{}watchover review \textless{}model files,\allowbreak{} merge-\allowbreak{}request diff or plan output\textgreater{}}}
\refrow{Does}{Review a proposed change for least privilege, guard violations and blast radius.}
\refrow{Delivers}{Findings by severity, failing guards, missing expectations, plan red flags (replacements).}
\refrow{How}{\begin{itemize}[nosep,leftmargin=1.2em]
\item Checks the input against the guards, least privilege (root scope, removed deny rules, associations without sub-claims) and plan red flags (replacements caused by renames).
\item Reports findings ranked by severity, with the missing expectations.
\end{itemize}
}
\end{woentry}

\section{\texttt{import}}\label{skill:import}
\begin{woentry}
\refrow{Syntax}{\texttt{akeyless-\allowbreak{}watchover import [what to export: everything /\allowbreak{} a type /\allowbreak{} one user's view] [export directory or REPORT.md]}}
\refrow{Does}{Export existing config (RBAC, auth methods incl. OIDC, folders, custom fields, key policies, PKI issuers, account settings) and translate it into Terraform.}
\refrow{Delivers}{The exact \texttt{watchover export} command (model or \mbox{-}\mbox{-}hcl mode, filters), then resolution of every REPORT.md item and the import checklist until the plan shows imports only.}
\refrow{How}{\begin{itemize}[nosep,leftmargin=1.2em]
\item Chooses the export mode (model or \mbox{-}\mbox{-}hcl) and filters, and gives the \texttt{watchover export} command.
\item Reads REPORT.md and resolves every item (secrets, unsupported types, external references).
\item Iterates until the plan shows imports only.
\end{itemize}
}
\end{woentry}

\section{\texttt{reconcile}}\label{skill:reconcile}
\begin{woentry}
\refrow{Syntax}{\texttt{akeyless-\allowbreak{}watchover reconcile [repository URL or checkout] [branch]}}
\refrow{Does}{Compare the governance repository (GitHub Enterprise) with live Akeyless and prepare the changes for manual review. Never commits or pushes.}
\refrow{Delivers}{REPORT.md with every difference and its two resolutions, changes.patch, proposed files, imports.tf - to review and commit yourself.}
\refrow{How}{\begin{itemize}[nosep,leftmargin=1.2em]
\item Clones the repository read-only (or reads a checkout) and runs \texttt{watchover reconcile} with a read-only Akeyless identity; without a shell, gives the command to run.
\item Explains each difference and asks whether Akeyless or the repository is right; adjusts the proposal (\mbox{-}\mbox{-}only, \mbox{-}\mbox{-}include-unmodelled, \mbox{-}\mbox{-}propose-removals).
\item Hands over the patch and files with the commands to apply and verify them (git apply, terraform plan). Never commits, pushes or opens a pull request.
\end{itemize}
}
\end{woentry}
\IfFileExists{sessions/reconcile.tex}{\input{sessions/reconcile.tex}}{}

\section{\texttt{harden}}\label{skill:harden}
\begin{woentry}
\refrow{Syntax}{\texttt{akeyless-\allowbreak{}watchover harden [current settings or concerns]}}
\refrow{Does}{Account-level hardening.}
\refrow{Delivers}{governance.yaml: account\_settings (Terraform), account\_settings\_cli (CLI), custom fields, key policies, event forwarders.}
\refrow{How}{\begin{itemize}[nosep,leftmargin=1.2em]
\item Splits the settings into the Terraform-managed subset (account\_settings) and the CLI-only part (account\_settings\_cli); adds custom fields, key policies and critical event forwarders.
\item Always starts with \texttt{watchover account-\allowbreak{}settings \mbox{-\allowbreak{}}\mbox{-\allowbreak{}}dry-\allowbreak{}run}.
\end{itemize}
}
\end{woentry}

\section{\texttt{verify}}\label{skill:verify}
\begin{woentry}
\refrow{Syntax}{\texttt{akeyless-\allowbreak{}watchover verify [persona \textbar{}\allowbreak{} path]}}
\refrow{Does}{Prove who can access what.}
\refrow{Delivers}{access\_expectations.yaml checks, \texttt{watchover simulate} / \texttt{watchover verify} commands, Impersonate As steps.}
\refrow{How}{\begin{itemize}[nosep,leftmargin=1.2em]
\item Evaluates access with the Akeyless rules (wildcards, deny precedence, sub-claims OR within a key / AND across keys).
\item Writes the matching expectation checks and the commands that prove them offline (\texttt{simulate}) and live (\texttt{verify}, Impersonate As).
\end{itemize}
}
\end{woentry}
